author: Fluffdawg287
body:
My minecraft username is BerrySmoothie_ and I just got banned for fly hacking. To start, I wasn't flying, I was lagging and so were a lot of other people who were saying so in the chat. a couple minutes before I got banned I was even saying how I was lagging. When i got banned I was building up a short wall to get to a platform where someone was. I guess it lagged and it looked like I flew up there. I have been playing avicus for a long time now and I wouldn't be as stupid as to risk getting banned from the server. I've been around since MCZone. And if I was a hacker then I would probably have a lot more kills, and in-game credits and be atleast higher up on the leaderboards. Please appeal my ban so I can go play again? Thank you.
-Berry


I have even put a link to a screen shot of my versions folder, and my desktop to prove I never had any version of a hack. 

http://imgur.com/rrpbCPd
http://imgur.com/YmV1z2r

Regards,
Mango_

replies.author: Iron
replies.body:
Hello, 

I have decided to deny your appeal. After reviewing the evidence provided to me, I believe it suffices, and therefore you will remain banned. Please look at this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JNLwjDt8vzs If you have any more questions please ask.

Thanks,
Iron,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
